village.name: Asharopatoi
village.osm_display_name: Asharopatoi, Shunail, Kalam Tehsil, Swat District, Malakand Division, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan

reasons: Houses of the village are on or next to (under 30 m from) the downhill path water would take out of Kalam north lake (34 km upstream), Utror lake B (36 km upstream) and Utror lake A (38 km upstream). (+20 points)
The vegetation loss upslope is on steep ground (mean slope 36°), where bare soil sheds water and can slide. (+15 points)
5.8 ha of vegetation loss in forest areas in 5 patches within 3 km upslope of the village (satellite, 2019-2025; cause not known). (+7 points)
